title: Acta thread frames — v1 contract
description: Provider-independent thread frame contracts. See ../thread-frame-schema.md for normalization, presentation and provider-specific boundaries.

Error.description: Displayable error information; raw provider details remain in the debug frame.

thread_id.description: Acta thread UUID, not the provider thread ID.

run_id.description: Acta identity of the provider process run.

sequence.description: Durable provider capture sequence, increasing across runs within this Acta thread.

output_index.description: 0 for the debug frame; 1..N for derived frames from the same captured input.

provider.description: Provider adapter identifier, for example codex.

received_at.description: Original local capture time; preserved on replay.

occurred_at.description: Provider event time if reported; null if unavailable. Never used for ordering.

Configuration.description: Acta configuration snapshot. Partial observations are merged by the adapter before emission. Omitted fields are unknown. fast_mode is strictly boolean when known; omit it otherwise. Provider-native settings stay in debug capture. Model IDs and effort choices are advertised by provider capabilities; unsupported efforts are not silently approximated.

TurnStarted.description: Establishes a turn. turn_id is opaque and scoped to the Acta thread; the adapter may retain the native turn ID.

TextPart.description: Only plain text is in the reviewed first slice. Non-empty structured text elements or other content parts must not be silently flattened; preserve in debug and extend the mapping when designed.

message_id.description: Stable normalized identity within this Acta thread. Live native item IDs may be used; reconstructed resume item IDs must not be assumed equivalent.

submission_id.description: Acta submission identity correlated by the adapter; absent for provider-originated messages.

UserMessage.description: Full user message snapshot. Correlation with provider-native client IDs belongs in the adapter. Optional submission_id correlates a known Acta send command. User role does not identify a specific human.

message_id.description: Stable normalized identity within this Acta thread. Live native item IDs may be used; reconstructed resume item IDs must not be assumed equivalent.

AssistantMessage.description: Full message snapshot/upsert. Completed text replaces accumulated deltas; phase does not establish completion. Non-null unreviewed citation/delivery/question fields need a mapping extension.

AssistantMessageDelta.description: Append this exact text once in source order. Repeated text is legal; deduplicate by envelope identity, not content. Never append after the message is finalized.

TokenBreakdown.description: Null means unavailable, never zero. Breakdown fields overlap; do not sum all counters.

ContextUsage.description: Acta semantics: context is current occupancy, cumulative is provider-thread lifetime model-call consumption, last_request is the latest model-call consumption (not necessarily a whole turn). Populate only when the adapter can establish that meaning; never infer occupancy from cumulative usage. Codex counter/reset semantics remain to be verified. Null means unavailable.

Credits.description: Provider-reported credits. Balance is a decimal string; do not infer currency or exhaustion of included allowance.

AccountUsage.description: Provider-account allowance bucket observed by this run. An empty windows array means no windows supplied. Windows have no primary/secondary special case. Bucket identity is not account identity; do not merge separate runs without verified account association.

MCPServerStatus.description: Latest startup state of this named MCP server in this provider run; not a permanent health guarantee.

raw.description: Original captured UTF-8 payload as text, before provider JSON parsing/string normalization, excluding line transport delimiter. Preserves numeric lexemes, whitespace and unknown fields. Stderr is plain text, not JSON-encoded a second time. Local configuration responses may be explicitly minimized and marked redacted to avoid transmitting credentials.

redacted.description: True when a local configuration response has been minimized before server delivery. Original capture remains local.

ProviderDiagnostic.description: Provider stderr, retained verbatim. Structured log parsing is deferred.

Permissions.description: Accepted practical provider-independent approval categories and separate access summaries. Native differences in the agreed mappings are acceptable. Report custom for genuinely different configurations and unknown when evidence is missing. Reporting never changes provider permissions.

estimated.description: True when the provider reports an estimate rather than measured occupancy.
